answer: Agents can be required to post a refundable deposit that unlocks slowly, like climbing a ridge: each new identity's voting weight starts near zero and grows only after months of honest, audited work. A forger spinning up a thousand fakes must lock a thousand deposits and wait out every climb, while one caught colluding forfeits its stake to the network. Patience becomes the ivory gate; a sybil swarm sits stuck on the lowest knoll, paying capital costs with nothing to show.
